## Tutorials

The Month() function returns the month part for a given date.

This function returns an integer between 1 and 12.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Month(#05/17/2017#);

---

Month(
date
)

---

SELECT Month(Date());

---

SELECT Month(BirthDate) FROM Employees;
```

## Tutorials

The MonthName() function returns the name of the month based on a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT MonthName(3);

---

MonthName(
number
,
abbreviate
)

---

SELECT WeekdayName(3, true);
```

## Tutorials

The Now() function returns the current date and time based on the computer's system date and time.

None.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT CustomerName, Now() AS CurrentDateTime
FROM Customers;

---

Now()
```

## Tutorials

The Second() function returns the seconds part of a time/datetime.

This function returns an integer between 0 and 59.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  Second(#14:48:23#);

---

Second(
time
)

---

SELECT 
  Second(Now());

---

SELECT 
  Second(#24/10/2016 11:18:34 PM#);
```

## Tutorials

The Time() function returns the current system time.

None.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT CustomerName, 
  Time() AS CurrentTime
FROM Customers;

---

Time()
```
